item.title: LOT-048: post-form engine (reply, edit, delete, new topic, MP)
item.body:
LOT-048 — post-form engine (HFRClient).

**Problem.** SwiftHFR could not write to the forum: reply, quote reply, edit, delete (first post included, which deletes the thread), new topic, new private message and MP reply had no engine.

**Cause / legacy.** Legacy posted a harvested dictionary in undefined order, sent unchecked boxes as `"0"`, overrode `pseudo`/`hash_check` with the main account's (Swift) or a global fallback (ObjC), fell back to `/bddpost.php`, stripped or kept emoji inconsistently, and called any `.hop` without a link a success (`W17b` was a "success").

**What changed, and why this wide.**
- `HFRClient/Posting/`: `PostingFlow` (`loadForm(at:in:)`, `reply`, `newTopic`, `newPrivateMessage`, `edit`, `delete(with:confirmingWholeTopic:)`), `PostingForm` (keeps the session that fetched it, so a form is always posted as the selected account, Q-8), `PostingBody` (browser form submission in document order, CRLF, form's own `hash_check`/`pseudo`/`verifrequet`), `PostingError` (`unconfirmed` = may have been posted, never retried), `PostingResult`, `PostOption`.
- Success = LOT-037 `success` **and** this write's own sentence (`W10`/`W11`/`W15`/`W16a`/`W19`); another confirmation (`W15`, `W18`) is `unconfirmed`. POST sent once, redirects not followed, 60 s.
- Refused before sending: non-BMP characters in text/subject/recipient (Q-3, `W12`), blank inputs, wrong composer, no action (no default), anonymous composer, first-post delete without explicit confirmation (visible subject **or** "Effacer l'intégralité du sujet" label), options/delete the form does not offer.
- `HFRParsing/Forms/HopFormLayout.swift` (new file, LOT-036's parser untouched): `ForumForm` loses where `content_form` and selects sit among inputs, and every captured body follows document order, so the poster needs it.
- Docs: spec `docs/lots/LOT-048-post-form-engine.md`, HFR-PROTOCOL §3.1/§6 updates and §6c `### LOT-048`, two capture-backlog rows (public-topic writes), AGENTS §11 learning, own LOTS row.

**Tests** (all through `PostingFlow.loadForm` + the write, on captured pages):
- `PostingCaptureTests` — differential vs captured `request_body`: `W10`, `W11`, `W13b` (byte-identical), `W13c`, `W14`, `W15`, `W16a`, `W19`; new topic field order (`R45a`).
- `PostingBodyOracleTests` — differential vs LOT-004 `legacy.post.pairs` on 14 composers (diffs: unchecked boxes, token).
- `PostingRefusalTests`, `PostingInputTests`, `PostingBodyTests`, `HopFormLayoutTests` — refusals (`W17b`, `W20a/b`, `W14x`, `W13cx`, `W11x`, `W17c`), unknown outcomes (transport, 500, 302, other pages), local checks, browser rules, layout on all 15 composers.
- Shown to fail without the change (17 mutations, each caught): legacy `"0"` boxes, no per-write sentence check, no non-BMP check, no whole-thread guard, edit without forced `delete` off, followed redirects, transport failures as `network`, subject-only first-post sign, textarea missing from layout, no token check, no blank check, no URL check, newlines preserved, no shape check, no `invalidRequest` mapping, no `verifrequet` check, no option check.

**Pending capture** (none blocks): public-topic reply/new topic/edit/delete answers and edit forms (only MP writes captured; another sentence is reported unconfirmed, never success).

Security review details
**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The new capability can publish content, send private messages and edit or delete content under the retained account session, with deletion potentially affecting an entire thread. Its effective authority is the supplied account's forum authority, not a newly introduced administrative credential. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Form URLs, final form-response URLs and submission destinations must use HTTPS on the exact forum host, without user information or a non-default port. Final-response validation precedes parsing and token storage. POST redirects are disabled, preventing redirect-based replay of the body. - _observed_ — Session binding prevents substitution of a different session at submission, but does not freeze the retained session's identity. Strong counterevidence to an ordinary account-switch attack is separate per-account ownership and existing-account reauthentication that validates identity before adopting new cookies. Arbitrary cookie mutation remains possible through the session API; no production posting path exploiting that capability was established. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The flow has no consumed-form or in-flight state: repeated or concurrent calls can independently submit the same form. Its documented protection is no internal retry, with uncertain outcomes delegated to caller recovery. This distinction bounds the duplicate-write guarantee without establishing an automatic replay defect. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — When integrating the posting UI, serialize each user write, retire its submission attempt after success or an unconfirmed result, and invalidate retained composers when account authority changes. This would make recovery and account-lifecycle ownership explicit rather than extending the current per-invocation guarantee by assumption.

Review round 1 (Fable, REQUEST CHANGES) handled in df2dade:

1. **Whole-topic delete fails closed.** `PostingForm.requiresWholeTopicConfirmation(isFirstPost:)` is true when any of these holds: the caller's hint, a form sign, or a thread that is not `cat=prive`. `delete(with:isFirstPost:confirmingWholeTopic:)` enforces it. The form signs are trusted only on private threads. Tests: `PostingGuardTests`, including your probe, built from R43a with the subject hidden and the label "Effacer ce message", in both its public and private forms. Also a public later post (R43b as category 13).
2. **One-line inputs.** A line break in a subject or recipient now throws `lineBreak(input)`. A value longer than the input's `maxlength`, counted in UTF-16 code units, throws `tooLong(input, maximum:)`. `HopFormLayout.maxLengths` reads the limit: `sujet` is 70 on R43a, R45a and R45b; `dest` has none.
3. **Capture priority.** The public-topic write rows are now **MVP priority** at the top of the capture backlog. The spec says what users see until those captures exist.
4. **Empty stored text on delete** is refused locally with `emptyInput(.text)`.
5. **Docs.** HFR-PROTOCOL §6 "Form encoding" now records X11 as settled and says LOT-048 always sends CRLF. The spec's Tests section names the file that holds `PostingBodyOracleTests`.

Each fix was checked by a mutation: 6 mutations, all caught. No CodeRabbit threads were open, because CodeRabbit skipped this PR.

+# LOT-048 — Post-form engine
+
+- **Module:** HFRClient (plus the form layout reader in HFRParsing)
+- **Difficulty / model:** difficult (Opus 5.5 → Fable)
+- **Issue:** none (claimed by the orchestrator in `docs/LOTS.md`, claim PR #34); old francoisgn/ios-app_SwiftHFR#76 (frozen history); audit D3 in [D](../audit/D-posting.md)
+- **Depends on:** LOT-036 (`HopFormParser`), LOT-037 (`HopResponseParser`), LOT-042 (`HFRSession`)
+
+Reply, quote reply, edit, delete (first post included, which deletes the thread), new topic, new private message and MP
+reply: fetch the composer's `hop` form with the **selected** account's session, fill it, submit it like a browser, and
+report success only when HFR confirmed this very write. Quote prefill building (LOT-049), the alert (LOT-050), flags
+(LOT-051), polls (LOT-054), MPStorage (LOT-052) and the multi-quote cookie clean-up after a quoting reply (LOT-049) are out.
+
+## Legacy sources
+
+Legacy app: `master` of ezzz/HFRnow (same lines as francoisgn/hfrnow @ `2440d79`).
+
+| Legacy | Replaced by |
+|---|---|
+| `Classes/AddMessageViewController.m:513-636` (`done`): POST of the harvested map; `allowvisitor`, `have_sondage`, `sticky`, `sticky_everywhere` only when `"1"`; `delete=1` only in delete mode; `pseudo` and `hash_check` from the selected account (stored hash, else the global one); text `removeEmoji`, `\n` → `\r\n`; overrides `sujet`, `subcat`, `dest`; cookies of the selected account | `PostingFlow` + `PostingBody` |
+| `AddMessageViewController.m:586-622`: `.hop` with `<a>`/`<input>` = refusal, otherwise success | LOT-037 classifier **and** the per-write sentence |
+| `AddMessageViewController.m:631`: "Votre message a peut être été posté malgré tout" on an exception | `PostingError.unconfirmed` |
+| `Classes/QuoteMessageViewController.m:209-290` (form harvest, checkbox `"1"`/`"0"`, `MsgIcon` when checked) | `HopFormParser` (LOT-036) + `HopFormParser.layout` + browser semantics |
+| `Classes/DeleteMessageViewController.m:44` (`isDeleteMode` YES: edit with `delete=1` and the unchanged text) | `PostingFlow.delete` |
+| `HFRswift/Swift/ReplyService.swift:144-185` (`postReply`: query items of the fetch URL merged into the POST, `pseudo` and `hash_check` of the **main** account, default action `/bddpost.php`) | not ported, see "Intentional differences" |
+| `ReplyService.swift:332` (`removeInactiveTopicOptionFlags`), `:991-1040` (`deleteMessage`, `delete=1`) | browser semantics (an unchecked box is not sent), `PostingFlow.delete` |
+| `HFRswift/Swift/AccountSessionService.swift:77-105` (`makeReplySessionContext`: main account's cookies, stored hash) | the form's own `hash_check` and `pseudo`, fetched and posted through the selected session |
+
+## Behaviour
+
+All in `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRClient/Posting/`, plus `HFRParsing/Forms/HopFormLayout.swift`.
+
+1. **Load** — `PostingFlow.loadForm(at:in:)` takes the composer URL (answer link, quote link, decoded edit link, new-topic
+   link, new-MP link) and an `HFRSession`. The URL must be `https` on `forum.hardware.fr`, default port, no user info
+   (`invalidFormURL`, nothing requested). GET through the session; the final URL after redirects must pass the same check (the session follows redirects to any `hardware.fr` host, LOT-042), else `invalidFormURL` and nothing is kept. The page
+   is parsed twice from the same string: `HopFormParser.parse` (LOT-036) for the fields, `HopFormParser.layout` for the
+   document order. No form: the page's `.hop` is classified (LOT-037); the logged-out sentence gives `notLoggedIn`,
+   anything else `formUnavailable(message:)` (`RA5`). An empty `hash_check` or `pseudo` (anonymous composer `R40b`) gives
+   `notLoggedIn`. The form's token is recorded in the session (`updateHashCheck`). The returned `PostingForm` keeps the
+   session it came from, so it can only be posted through it (Q-8).
+2. **Shape** (`PostingForm.Shape`) — a non-empty `numreponse` is an edit form (`R43a`-`R44`); else a visible `sujet` with a
+   `dest` field is a new MP (`R45b`), without one a new topic (`R45a`); else a reply composer (`R40a`, `R41a`, `R41b`, `R42`,
+   `R47a`-`R47u1`). Each write requires its shape (`formMismatch`): `reply` ↔ reply, `newTopic` ↔ new topic,
+   `newPrivateMessage` ↔ new MP, `edit` and `delete` ↔ edit.
+3. **Local checks** (nothing sent): text, subject and recipient must not be blank (`emptyInput`); a character with a scalar
+   above U+FFFF in any of them is refused (`unsupportedCharacters(input, characters)`, Q-3: HFR cuts the text there and
+   answers success, `W12`); a sub-category must be one of the select's option values; a subject on an edit only when the
+   form shows it (`R43a`); a subject or a recipient holding a line break (`lineBreak`) or longer than the input's
+   `maxlength` in UTF-16 code units (`tooLong`; `sujet` 70 on `R43a`, `R45a`, `R45b`; `dest` has none) is refused; options (`[PostOption: Bool]`: boxes `signature`, `smiley`, `emaill`) only when the form has that box; delete
+   needs the `delete` box (`R44` has none) and a non-blank stored text (HFR refuses an empty one, `W17a`), and
+   `confirmingWholeTopic: true` whenever `requiresWholeTopicConfirmation(isFirstPost:)` is true (next item).
+4. **First post** — `PostingForm.deletesWholeTopic` is true when the edit form shows the subject **or** its `delete` label
+   says "intégralité" ("Effacer l'intégralité du sujet", `R43a`; a later post: hidden subject and "Effacer ce message",
+   `R43b`). Either sign is enough, so a page showing only one still asks for confirmation. These signs are verified on
+   private messages only, so they are trusted only when the form's hidden `cat` is `prive`:
+   `requiresWholeTopicConfirmation(isFirstPost:)` is true when the caller says the message is the first post (the
+   topic page knows it), when the form shows a sign, **or** when the thread is not private. Every public delete asks
+   for confirmation until a public first-post edit form is captured (fail closed).
+5. **Body** (`PostingBody.make`, browser form submission): walk the controls in document order; send text, hidden and
+   password inputs with their value (or an override: `sujet`, `dest`), a checkbox or radio only when checked (with
+   the options and the flow's own `delete` value applied to checkboxes only), the first submit input only, a select's
+   override or effective value (none when it has no option), `content_form` with the text; skip disabled controls, empty
+   names and buttons. Refused (`unsupportedForm`): an input of an unknown type, another textarea, no enabled
+   `content_form`, no `verifrequet` (copied from the form, never added: every write carries `1100`, HFR-PROTOCOL §7 X4),
+   or a layout that does not list the parsed fields and selects in order. Encoding: `FormBody` with CRLF line breaks.
+   `pseudo` and `hash_check` are the form's (the selected account's); nothing from the fetch URL is merged.
+6. **Writes** — `reply`, `newTopic(subject:subcategory:text:)` (nil sub-category: the form's selected option, else the
+   first, "Aucune" on `R45a`), `newPrivateMessage(to:subject:text:)`, `edit(_:subject:)` (sends `delete` unchecked even if
+   the page served it checked), `delete(with:isFirstPost:confirmingWholeTopic:)` (stored text sent back, `delete=1`).
+7. **POST** — to the form's `action` (forum-origin path from LOT-036; nil or off-origin → `missingAction`, no default),
+   `application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-8`, 60 s (legacy writes had URLSession's default), redirects **not
+   followed** (a 3xx is classified, never re-sent elsewhere). Sent once; cancellation is checked right before. A session
+   refusal before sending (`invalidRequest`) is `network`; any other failure of the exchange (timeout, offline, lost
+   connection, cancellation, HTTP 4xx/5xx) is `unconfirmed(.transport)`.
+8. **Confirmation** — `HopResponseParser.classify(context: .write)`: `success` **and** the `.hop` sentence equal to this
+   write's (`PostingAction.confirmation`): reply "Votre réponse a été postée avec succès !", new topic and new MP "Votre
+   message a été posté avec succès !", edit "Votre message a été édité avec succès !", delete "Message effacé avec succès !".
+   Another confirmation is `unconfirmed(.unexpectedConfirmation)`; `rejected` is `rejected(message:)`; `loggedOut` is
+   `notLoggedIn`; anything else (or an unreadable page) `unconfirmed(.unrecognizedAnswer)`. Success returns
+   `PostingResult` (sentence, refresh URL and anchor, `numreponse` of an edited or deleted message).
+
+Errors carry no user text, token or cookie; `rejected` and `formUnavailable` carry HFR's sentence, `unsupportedCharacters`
+the refused characters. Every case except `unconfirmed` means nothing was posted.
+
+## Edge cases
+
+- Double post: a POST is never resent by the engine; `unconfirmed` tells the app to let the user check the topic.
+- A redirect answering the POST is not followed (a 307/308 would re-POST): `unconfirmed`.
+- A form fetched with account A cannot be posted with account B: the form carries its session.
+- A form served with `delete` checked never deletes through `edit`, `reply`, `newTopic` or `newPrivateMessage`: every write but `delete` sends the box unchecked.
+- Several submit inputs: only the first is sent, as if clicked (captured forms have one, `submit`). A `<button name>` is
+  never sent. A checkbox without a `value` attribute would be sent with an empty value (a browser sends `on`); every
+  captured box has `value="1"`.
+- Repeated names are all sent, in order.
+- Characters inside the BMP (é, ☺, ❤) are sent; whether HFR keeps every BMP emoji is HFR-PROTOCOL §7b B13.
+
+## Fixtures
+
+Shared corpus only, no new file. Forms `R40a`, `R40b`, `R41a`, `R41b`, `R42`, `R43a`-`R43c`, `R44`, `R45a`, `R45b`, `R47a`-`R47u1`;
+answers `W10`-`W20b` and their metas (`request_body`, `request_fields`, `url`); `RA5`, `W01`, `W18`, `R08-1` as other pages;
+LOT-004 `form` oracles (`legacy.post.pairs`, `legacy.postedContent`). A few tests edit one attribute of a captured page
+(remove the action, check `delete`, hide the subject, rename a box) to reach a structural edge; none stands for a captured
+state.
+
+## Tests
+
+- `PostingCaptureTests` (differential, captured requests): `W10` (new MP from `R45b`), `W11` (reply, LF sent as CRLF), `W13b`
+  (byte-identical body), `W13c` (signature option, `R47u1`), `W14` (multi-quote prefill), `W15` (edit, no `delete`), `W16a`
+  (delete), `W19` (whole thread, confirmed); the body equals the captured `request_body` once legacy's `"0"` boxes are
+  dropped and line breaks written CRLF; URL, content type, timeout, no-redirect policy, recorded token, result sentence,
+  anchor and `numreponse`. New topic from `R45a`: field order with the select in place.
+- `PostingBodyOracleTests` (in `PostingBodyTests.swift`, differential, LOT-004): on the 14 logged-in composers, the fields and values equal legacy's
+  `post.pairs` except the unchecked boxes and the token.
+- `PostingRefusalTests`: captured refusals (`W17b`, `W20a`, `W20b`, `W14x`, `W13cx`, `W11x`), `W17c` logged out, another write's
+  confirmation (`W15`, `W18`), unknown pages, transport failures and HTTP 500 after the POST (unconfirmed, one POST), a 302
+  answer, a session refusal, `R40b`, an empty token, `RA5` and `W17c` as form pages, form request failure, off-forum form
+  URLs, absent and off-origin actions.
+- `PostingInputTests`: non-BMP in text, subject, recipient (`W12`'s emoji), blank inputs (`W17a`), shapes of every captured
+  composer, form mismatches, `R44` delete, unconfirmed whole-thread delete and both first-post signs, edit with `delete`
+  served checked, subject on a later post, unknown sub-category, option not offered.
+- `PostingGuardTests`: a probe derived from `R43a` (neither first-post sign) as a public topic needs confirmation; the
+  `isFirstPost` hint on the private probe; a later post of a public topic (`R43b` as category 13); empty stored text on
+  delete; line breaks and `maxlength` in subjects and recipients.
+- `PostingBodyTests`: browser rules on small models (disabled, unnamed, second submit, button, repeated names, radio vs
+  checkbox overrides, select overrides and empty selects, unsupported forms).
+- `HopFormLayoutTests` (HFRParsing): indices match `parse` on all 15 composers, `content_form` and `subcat` positions, delete
+  labels, disabled controls and buttons, missing form.
+
+Shown to fail without the change: legacy `"0"` boxes, no per-write sentence check, no non-BMP check, no whole-thread
+guard, edit without the forced `delete` off, followed redirects, transport failures as `network`, the subject-only
+first-post sign, the textarea missing from the layout, no token check, no blank check, no form URL check, newlines
+preserved, no shape distinction, no `invalidRequest` mapping, no `verifrequet` check, no option check; after the Fable review: public deletes trusted to the form signs, no `isFirstPost` hint, no empty-text check on delete, no line-break check, no `maxlength` check, `maxlength` not read; after round 2: `delete` not forced off on non-delete writes, final form URL not checked.
+
+## Intentional differences from legacy
+
+1. **Browser checkbox semantics**: an unchecked box is not sent (legacy `"0"`); HFR reads values, both work (`W11`, `W13b`),
+   and an edit can never carry `delete`.
+2. **Document order** of the page (legacy: dictionary order).
+3. **The form's `pseudo` and `hash_check`**, through the session that served the form; legacy ObjC used the selected
+   account's stored hash with a global fallback, legacy Swift the main account's (Q-8 decided: selected account). An empty
+   token stops the write (`notLoggedIn`) instead of posting with a stored one.
+4. **Success needs HFR's confirmation and this write's sentence** (legacy: no link in `.hop`; `W17b` was a "success").
+5. **No default action** (legacy `/bddpost.php`), and no fetch-URL query items merged (legacy Swift).
+6. **Non-BMP characters refused**, not stripped (legacy ObjC `removeEmoji` stripped some ranges and kept others, legacy Swift
+   sent them and lost the end of the text).
+7. **Blank text refused locally** (legacy ObjC sent it; HFR refuses an empty one, `W17a`).
+8. **Deleting a first post is offered**, behind an explicit confirmation (legacy UI never offered it).
+9. **Unknown outcome is its own error**; the engine never resends.
+
+## Pending capture
+
+Not hand-built (LESSONS 36). None blocks the lot; until captured, each state is handled conservatively. The first two are
+**MVP priority** in the capture backlog: until they are captured, every public reply, new topic, edit and delete surfaces
+as `unconfirmed` unless HFR answers with LOT-037's success shape (link-less `.hop`, "avec succès", refresh to the forum)
+**and** the MP sentence of that write, and every public delete asks for whole-topic confirmation.
+- **Public-topic answers**: a reply, a new topic, an edit and a delete in a forum topic (`cat=<forum>`). Only private-message
+  writes are captured; a public write is a success only with LOT-037's `success` (refresh URL included) and the MP sentence of
+  that write; another sentence, or a missing refresh, is reported `unconfirmed`, never success.

+import Foundation
+import HFRModels
+import HFRNetwork
+import HFRParsing
+
+/// Posts to HFR the way its own pages do: fetch the composer's `hop` form with the account's session, fill it, submit it
+/// like a browser, and report success only when HFR confirmed this very write (LOT-048, audit D3).
+///
+/// Every write runs in the session of the **selected** account (decision Q-8): the form is fetched and posted through
+/// it, and its own `hash_check` and `pseudo` are sent (legacy Swift posted with the main account's,
+/// `AccountSessionService.swift:77-105`). A POST is sent once and never retried: when its outcome is not read,
+/// the flow throws `unconfirmed` (legacy: "Votre message a peut être été posté malgré tout",
+/// `AddMessageViewController.m:631`).
+public struct PostingFlow: Sendable {
+    /// Creates the flow.
+    public init() {}
+
+    /// Fetches the write form at `url` (answer, quote, edit, new-topic or new-MP link) through `session`.
+    ///
+    /// The page must hold a `hop` form with a non-empty `hash_check` and `pseudo`; the token is recorded in the session.
+    /// - Throws: `invalidFormURL`, `notLoggedIn`, `formUnavailable` (no form: locked topic, message not for this account),
+    ///   `unsupportedForm`, `network`.
+    public func loadForm(at url: URL, in session: HFRSession) async throws(PostingError) -> PostingForm {
+        try await loadForm(at: url, through: session)
+    }
+
+    /// Replies with `text` through a reply or quote form (`PostingForm.Shape.reply`), topic or private message.
+    public func reply(_ text: String, options: [PostOption: Bool] = [:], with form: PostingForm)
+        async throws(PostingError) -> PostingResult {
+        try require(form, is: .reply)
+        try checkText(text)
+        return try await submit(.reply, form: form, text: text, overrides: [:], options: options)
+    }
+
+    /// Starts a topic. `subcategory` is one of `form.form.subcategories`' values; nil sends the form's own choice
+    /// (the selected option, else the first one, "Aucune" on `R45a`).
+    public func newTopic(
+        subject: String, subcategory: String? = nil, text: String, options: [PostOption: Bool] = [:], with form: PostingForm
+    ) async throws(PostingError) -> PostingResult {
+        try require(form, is: .newTopic)
+        try checkInput(subject, as: .subject)
+        try checkText(text)
+        var overrides = ["sujet": subject]
+        if let subcategory {
+            guard form.form.subcategories.contains(where: { $0.value == subcategory }) else { throw .unknownSubcategory }
+            overrides["subcat"] = subcategory
+        }
+        return try await submit(.newTopic, form: form, text: text, overrides: overrides, options: options)
+    }
+
+    /// Starts a private-message thread with `recipient`.
+    public func newPrivateMessage(
+        to recipient: String, subject: String, text: String, options: [PostOption: Bool] = [:], with form: PostingForm
+    ) async throws(PostingError) -> PostingResult {
+        try require(form, is: .newPrivateMessage)
+        try checkInput(recipient, as: .recipient)
+        try checkInput(subject, as: .subject)
+        try checkText(text)
+        return try await submit(
+            .newPrivateMessage, form: form, text: text, overrides: ["dest": recipient, "sujet": subject], options: options
+        )
+    }

+   `pseudo` and `hash_check` are the form's (the selected account's); nothing from the fetch URL is merged.
+6. **Writes** — `reply`, `newTopic(subject:subcategory:text:)` (nil sub-category: the form's selected option, else the
+   first, "Aucune" on `R45a`), `newPrivateMessage(to:subject:text:)`, `edit(_:subject:)` (sends `delete` unchecked even if
+   the page served it checked), `delete(with:isFirstPost:confirmingWholeTopic:)` (stored text sent back, `delete=1`).
+7. **POST** — to the form's `action` (forum-origin path from LOT-036; nil or off-origin → `missingAction`, no default),
+   `application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-8`, 60 s (legacy writes had URLSession's default), redirects **not
+   followed** (a 3xx is classified, never re-sent elsewhere). Sent once; cancellation is checked right before. A session
+   refusal before sending (`invalidRequest`) is `network`; any other failure of the exchange (timeout, offline, lost
+   connection, cancellation, HTTP 4xx/5xx) is `unconfirmed(.transport)`.
+8. **Confirmation** — `HopResponseParser.classify(context: .write)`: `success` **and** the `.hop` sentence equal to this
+   write's (`PostingAction.confirmation`): reply "Votre réponse a été postée avec succès !", new topic and new MP "Votre
+   message a été posté avec succès !", edit "Votre message a été édité avec succès !", delete "Message effacé avec succès !".
+   Another confirmation is `unconfirmed(.unexpectedConfirmation)`; `rejected` is `rejected(message:)`; `loggedOut` is
+   `notLoggedIn`; anything else (or an unreadable page) `unconfirmed(.unrecognizedAnswer)`. Success returns
+   `PostingResult` (sentence, refresh URL and anchor, `numreponse` of an edited or deleted message).
+
+Errors carry no user text, token or cookie; `rejected` and `formUnavailable` carry HFR's sentence, `unsupportedCharacters`
+the refused characters. Every case except `unconfirmed` means nothing was posted.
+
+## Edge cases
+
+- Double post: a POST is never resent by the engine; `unconfirmed` tells the app to let the user check the topic.
+- A redirect answering the POST is not followed (a 307/308 would re-POST): `unconfirmed`.
+- A form fetched with account A cannot be posted with account B: the form carries its session.
+- A form served with `delete` checked never deletes through `edit`, `reply`, `newTopic` or `newPrivateMessage`: every write but `delete` sends the box unchecked.
+- Several submit inputs: only the first is sent, as if clicked (captured forms have one, `submit`). A `<button name>` is
+  never sent. A checkbox without a `value` attribute would be sent with an empty value (a browser sends `on`); every
+  captured box has `value="1"`.
+- Repeated names are all sent, in order.
+- Characters inside the BMP (é, ☺, ❤) are sent; whether HFR keeps every BMP emoji is HFR-PROTOCOL §7b B13.
+
+## Fixtures
+
+Shared corpus only, no new file. Forms `R40a`, `R40b`, `R41a`, `R41b`, `R42`, `R43a`-`R43c`, `R44`, `R45a`, `R45b`, `R47a`-`R47u1`;
+answers `W10`-`W20b` and their metas (`request_body`, `request_fields`, `url`); `RA5`, `W01`, `W18`, `R08-1` as other pages;
+LOT-004 `form` oracles (`legacy.post.pairs`, `legacy.postedContent`). A few tests edit one attribute of a captured page
+(remove the action, check `delete`, hide the subject, rename a box) to reach a structural edge; none stands for a captured
+state.
+
+## Tests
+
+- `PostingCaptureTests` (differential, captured requests): `W10` (new MP from `R45b`), `W11` (reply, LF sent as CRLF), `W13b`
+  (byte-identical body), `W13c` (signature option, `R47u1`), `W14` (multi-quote prefill), `W15` (edit, no `delete`), `W16a`
+  (delete), `W19` (whole thread, confirmed); the body equals the captured `request_body` once legacy's `"0"` boxes are
+  dropped and line breaks written CRLF; URL, content type, timeout, no-redirect policy, recorded token, result sentence,
+  anchor and `numreponse`. New topic from `R45a`: field order with the select in place.
+- `PostingBodyOracleTests` (in `PostingBodyTests.swift`, differential, LOT-004): on the 14 logged-in composers, the fields and values equal legacy's
+  `post.pairs` except the unchecked boxes and the token.
+- `PostingRefusalTests`: captured refusals (`W17b`, `W20a`, `W20b`, `W14x`, `W13cx`, `W11x`), `W17c` logged out, another write's
+  confirmation (`W15`, `W18`), unknown pages, transport failures and HTTP 500 after the POST (unconfirmed, one POST), a 302
+  answer, a session refusal, `R40b`, an empty token, `RA5` and `W17c` as form pages, form request failure, off-forum form
+  URLs, absent and off-origin actions.
+- `PostingInputTests`: non-BMP in text, subject, recipient (`W12`'s emoji), blank inputs (`W17a`), shapes of every captured
+  composer, form mismatches, `R44` delete, unconfirmed whole-thread delete and both first-post signs, edit with `delete`
+  served checked, subject on a later post, unknown sub-category, option not offered.
+- `PostingGuardTests`: a probe derived from `R43a` (neither first-post sign) as a public topic needs confirmation; the
+  `isFirstPost` hint on the private probe; a later post of a public topic (`R43b` as category 13); empty stored text on
+  delete; line breaks and `maxlength` in subjects and recipients.
+- `PostingBodyTests`: browser rules on small models (disabled, unnamed, second submit, button, repeated names, radio vs
+  checkbox overrides, select overrides and empty selects, unsupported forms).
+- `HopFormLayoutTests` (HFRParsing): indices match `parse` on all 15 composers, `content_form` and `subcat` positions, delete
+  labels, disabled controls and buttons, missing form.
+
+Shown to fail without the change: legacy `"0"` boxes, no per-write sentence check, no non-BMP check, no whole-thread
+guard, edit without the forced `delete` off, followed redirects, transport failures as `network`, the subject-only
+first-post sign, the textarea missing from the layout, no token check, no blank check, no form URL check, newlines
+preserved, no shape distinction, no `invalidRequest` mapping, no `verifrequet` check, no option check; after the Fable review: public deletes trusted to the form signs, no `isFirstPost` hint, no empty-text check on delete, no line-break check, no `maxlength` check, `maxlength` not read; after round 2: `delete` not forced off on non-delete writes, final form URL not checked.
+
+## Intentional differences from legacy
+
+1. **Browser checkbox semantics**: an unchecked box is not sent (legacy `"0"`); HFR reads values, both work (`W11`, `W13b`),
+   and an edit can never carry `delete`.
+2. **Document order** of the page (legacy: dictionary order).
+3. **The form's `pseudo` and `hash_check`**, through the session that served the form; legacy ObjC used the selected
+   account's stored hash with a global fallback, legacy Swift the main account's (Q-8 decided: selected account). An empty
+   token stops the write (`notLoggedIn`) instead of posting with a stored one.
+4. **Success needs HFR's confirmation and this write's sentence** (legacy: no link in `.hop`; `W17b` was a "success").
+5. **No default action** (legacy `/bddpost.php`), and no fetch-URL query items merged (legacy Swift).
+6. **Non-BMP characters refused**, not stripped (legacy ObjC `removeEmoji` stripped some ranges and kept others, legacy Swift
+   sent them and lost the end of the text).
+7. **Blank text refused locally** (legacy ObjC sent it; HFR refuses an empty one, `W17a`).
+8. **Deleting a first post is offered**, behind an explicit confirmation (legacy UI never offered it).
+9. **Unknown outcome is its own error**; the engine never resends.
+
+## Pending capture
+
+Not hand-built (LESSONS 36). None blocks the lot; until captured, each state is handled conservatively. The first two are
+**MVP priority** in the capture backlog: until they are captured, every public reply, new topic, edit and delete surfaces
+as `unconfirmed` unless HFR answers with LOT-037's success shape (link-less `.hop`, "avec succès", refresh to the forum)
+**and** the MP sentence of that write, and every public delete asks for whole-topic confirmation.
+- **Public-topic answers**: a reply, a new topic, an edit and a delete in a forum topic (`cat=<forum>`). Only private-message
+  writes are captured; a public write is a success only with LOT-037's `success` (refresh URL included) and the MP sentence of
+  that write; another sentence, or a missing refresh, is reported `unconfirmed`, never success.
